text.p: Nabisco Holdings Corp said Monday that so far, it has fully realized savings projected from its restructuring program.

Nabisco reported earnings of $0.06 a share for 1996, including $525 million in restructuring-related charges. This compares with $1.13 a share in 1995, which included a charge of $0.07 a share for early extinguishment of debt.
A company spokesman told Reuters that Nabisco realized $47 million in savings from its restructuring program in 1996.
The company said that it projects its savings to reach $200 million a year in 1998 and beyond.
It said that the bulk of these savings will be invested in marketing and product development programs.
